description: Mediation Boards Commission - Amended the closing date of calling for nominations for the appointment of mediators notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1914/39 of 15.05.2015
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the Mediation Boards Commission's administrative process for calling nominations for the appointment of Mediators. It is a public service recruitment/advertisement notice issued by a government commission, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with public sector administrative procedures and appointments to a public service body.
